{{Otheruses|Sexagenary cycle|西涼の元号|庚子 (西涼)}}

{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yang Metal Rat''' (庚子, ''kanoe nezumi''; onyomi ''kōshi'') is the 37th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 37th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Earth Pig|ja|己亥|1=Yin Earth Pig}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Metal Ox|ja|辛丑|1=Yin Metal Ox}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''庚'' is Yang Metal, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''子'' (Rat) is Yang Water; together they form a Mutual Generation relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.
==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Metal Rat (庚子)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): gēngzǐ
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gaang1 zi2
** Japanese:
***Kunyomi 1: Kanoe-ne
***Kunyomi 2: koukin-no-ne
***Onyomi 1: koushi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gyeongja (경자)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Canh Tý

==Months of Yang Metal Rat==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 1 or 6 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Sin|ja|辛|1=Kanoto (辛)|lt=Kanoto (辛)|2=ja|3=辛|4=zh|5=辛|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Sin}} and {{ill|Hei|ja|丙|1=Hinoe (丙)|lt=Hinoe (丙)|2=ja|3=丙|4=zh|5=丙|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hei}}), the month of {{ill|November|en|November|qid=Q125|lt=November|1=November}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month|1=Month}} of {{ill|Koushi|ja|庚子|1=Yang Metal Rat|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Koushi|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Lunisolar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the seasonal month (from {{ill|Daxue (solar term)|en|Daxue (solar term)|qid=Q337815|lt=Heavy Snow|1=Daxue (solar term)}} until the day before {{ill|Xiaohan|en|Xiaohan|qid=Q1190989|lt=Lesser Cold|1=Xiaohan}}) as applicable.

==Days of Yang Metal Rat==
=== Selected Day (選日) ===
The day of {{ill|Koushi|ja|庚子|1=Yang Metal Rat|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Koushi|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is the 8th day of {{ill|Ten Ten Ichijō|ja|天一天上|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ten Ten Ichijō|ja_comment=天一神|1=Tenitsu-shin|2=ja|3=天一神|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11442153}}.
